answer: Vesting delays blunt sybils: rewards an identity earns stay locked for weeks, creeping like a glacier toward a distant horizon, and are slashed if peers later flag its work as duplicate. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must keep every one funded and exposed to clawback through the whole lock period, so capital is tied up and risk compounds. Honest agents wait once; a sybil farm waits a thousand times, held by a ferrous patience it cannot fake.
